description: Week-by-week NASS crop condition ratings for corn, soybeans, or wheat across the growing season — each week's excellent/good/fair/poor/very poor shares plus a combined good+excellent percentage — from USDA NASS QuickStats. Use to track crop health trends or compare weeks within the season; use get_crop_condition instead when only the latest week matters. Read-only lookup of stored statistics; no API key. Returns up to `weeks` most recent stored weeks, oldest first (default 12, max 52); coverage is the current season, national plus major corn-belt states, and the stored copy refreshes weekly.

geography.description: US for national, or state code (IA, IL, etc.); state coverage is the major corn-belt states. Default: US

weeks.description: Number of most recent weeks to return (default 12, max 52)

name: get_crop_condition_history
